description: This file is a React component for an admin interface in a frontend application. It allows admin users to upload, parse, compare, and seed data related to roles, competencies, role competencies, and adjacency matrices into a Supabase backend. It includes file reading and parsing logic for XLSX and TXT formats, data diffing against existing database entries, and interaction with backend API and authentication checks.

methods.name: normalizeKey
methods.description: Normalizes header keys from sheets or text input for consistent parsing.

methods.name: readFile
methods.description: Reads a File object as an ArrayBuffer if XLSX, or text if TXT.

methods.name: parseXlsx
methods.description: Parses an XLSX buffer, detects sheets based on header heuristics, and extracts roles, competencies, role competencies, and adjacency data.

methods.name: parseTxtRoleCard
methods.description: Parses minimal role card data from a plain text string, heuristically extracting role title and code.

methods.name: mergePayloads
methods.description: Merges multiple partial parsed payloads into a deduplicated, complete payload.

methods.name: fetchSnapshot
methods.description: Fetches existing roles, competencies, role_compatibilities, and adjacency data from the database for diffing.

methods.name: computeDiff
methods.description: Computes the number of new entries vs existing database entries based on payload and snapshot.

methods.name: checkIsAdmin
methods.description: Checks whether current user has admin privileges based on records in 'admin_users' table.
